findings.failing_input: Early return on empty array; subtle: lineItems=null doesn't reach the guard because the ?. propagates null but the conditional is `!lineItems || lineItems.length === 0`. Both branches handled.

uncertainty_notes: Pure-TS mirror of Apps Script computeLineItemsCad_. KEEP-IN-SYNC contract documented + WR-01 pitfall (subtotal denominator includes custom items) is explicit. Tests cover: even split (2 items), unequal split (3 items), dominant item ratio, zero total, flat-spread (subtotal=0 free-gift case), and empty productId skip. 6 cases pin the proportional-split contract within 1¢ tolerance per item.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No test that mixed orders (real product + custom item) correctly share the denominator.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: WR-01 specifically warns about over-crediting the real product if denominator excludes custom items.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: computeLineItemsCad(100, [{productId:'p-1',price:50,quantity:1}, {productId:'',price:50,quantity:1}]) → output array has 1 entry (p-1) with revenueCad=50 (NOT 100).

test_coverage_gaps.description: No test for the round2 rounding behavior at the half-cent boundary.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: Math.round half-rounding behavior differs across runtimes.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: computeLineItemsCad(0.025, [{...}]) → assert exact half-cent rounding behavior.
